actual: The official qe_eval_v2 metric engine does not produce the persisted h20/T21T1 HAC companion fields, so a full factor recompute leaves all new h20 columns null. Factor metrics/correlation MCP plan and validate-inputs also report a capped 100-factor preview as if it were the eligible count and do not expose official cache snapshot/integrity/moneyflow-contract blockers before an expensive full run. Implement actual h20 metrics and honest read-only preflight readiness without changing legacy 1d results.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
